## Opponent Reads

**Player 2**: **LAG/maniac, extreme calling station postflop AS PFA.** Opens very wide (~50% PFR). 4-bets and 3-bets extremely wide — including with premiums (AA). **As PFA**: Calls down with virtually anything — including calling multi-street donk-leads with just overcards. C-bets most flops, checks dry/paired boards. Turn: AIR → checks/folds (float profitable); MEDIUM HANDS → checks turn, calls river (station mode); REAL HANDS → shoves aggressively. Folds to turn raises even after double-barreling. **As NON-PFA (BB defend, etc.)**: Fit-or-fold — folds to c-bets when whiffing. Stabs turn with marginal holdings but gives up river on scary boards. **DONK-LEADS with strong made hands (especially in 3-bet pots).** **CHECK-RAISES with semi-bluffs/draws on wet boards** — barrels turn with equity, CHECK-FOLDS river when draw misses. **Key line: P2 check-raise flop → bet turn → check river = BUSTED DRAW — attack with river bet.** Calls 3-bets with pocket pairs (including JJ). **Exploit**: Flat opens IP with suited broadways/connectors. 3-bet QQ+/AKs only. Value bet extremely thin as PFA. Float flop c-bets. DO NOT bluff when P2 is calling with made hands. DO bluff when P2's line = busted draw. As 3-bet caller: c-bet when P2 checks (will fold air); FOLD to P2's donk-lead + turn aggression (strong).

**Player 3**: **Tight-aggressive, skilled — most dangerous opponent (~7% VPIP in raised pots). STICKIER THAN EXPECTED in limped/multiway pots** — completes SB wide (including QJo), then plays aggressively postflop. 3-bets from blinds vs ALL positions. **Confirmed trapper — wide check-raise range in BOTH 3-bet pots AND limped pots.** Will CHECK-RAISE ALL-IN with as little as top pair in limped pots — not just monsters. C-betting is SELECTIVE. Triple-barrels one-pair value. **Vs RAISED POTS with escalating pressure**: calls flop+turn then folds river to size. **Vs LIMPED/SMALL POTS: stickier AND more aggressive — check-raises with top pair, calls down light.** **Session 5 note: P3 accumulated heavily (+$485) — likely running well and/or exploiting table.** **Exploit**: Multi-street barrels work in raised pots. In limped pots, don't bluff into P3 — they fight back. Value bet wider in limped pots. Good steal target in blinds.

**Player 4**: **Loose-passive preflop, WILDLY UNPREDICTABLE postflop — part station, part maniac.** Calls wide preflop (3-bets with junk, limps wide). **CRITICAL: Capable of MASSIVE bluffs — confirmed shoved all-in with complete air (7-high, no draw) on paired board in limped pot.** Also bets multiway flops with marginal holdings (middle pair + backdoor draws). As LIMPER: Will bet flop AND shove turn with ZERO equity. ALSO still a calling station — calls river with bottom pair, 9-high. **Dual nature: bluffs huge AND calls down light.** PASSIVE with strong made hands — checks made straights through all streets. **3-bets are strong (JJ+/AQ+) but folds to 4-bets. 5-BET SHOVE includes JJ.** As single-raiser: C-bets flop, folds to turn raises — FLOATABLE. **Exploit**: Value bet extremely wide (still #1 value target when calling). BUT DON'T auto-fold to P4's aggression in limped pots — their bets/shoves can be pure air. CALL DOWN wider vs P4's aggression (especially in limped pots). In raised pots as PFA, still floatable.

**Player 5**: **Very tight nit (~7% VPIP), sticky with pocket pairs.** C-bets flop then shuts down without connection. Donk-bets can be strong OR weak — weak ones fold to raises/turn barrels; strong ones ESCALATE. **ANY turn raise from P5 = monster.** **Exploit**: Two-barrel bluff donk-bets. Call flop c-bets wider. FOLD to P5's turn raises always. Good steal target in blinds.

**Player 6**: **Station/spewy — wide limper, opener, AND cold-caller. More competent than raw classification suggests. SESSION 5 BIG WINNER (+$830).** **As LIMPER: EXTREMELY sticky postflop — calls with bottom pair. Folds preflop to large iso-raises.** **As COLD-CALLER: Donk-leads with AIR/weak draws → RAISE for fold equity. CHECK-CALLS with real made hands — passive line = actual hand.** Key tell: P6 donk-lead = air; P6 check-call = real hand. **P6 RAISES/RE-RAISES can be SEMI-BLUFFS with combo draws (pair + flush draw confirmed).** Willing to get stacks in with draws on wet boards. MASSIVE overbets = value. **4-bet shoves are NUTTED.** **Exploit**: Value bet wide. SIZE DOWN iso-raises (~3x) to keep P6 in. NEVER bluff check-calling P6. RAISE donk-leads (they're air). FOLD to 4-bet shoves/overbets. On wet boards, P6's raises may be semi-bluff draws — can call with made hands.

**Player 7**: **CONFIRMED extremely wide opener — opens trash hands (T3o from MP).** Can go long stretches without raising then open with complete junk. DON'T assume P7 opens are strong just because they're infrequent. **Wide limper too. PREFLOP MANIAC in escalated pots** — calls 5-bets with QQ/suited junk, 6-bets with weak aces. Any Ax or pocket pair = "premium" in reraised pots. **Postflop**: Commits with made hands (two pair+) — will 3-bet flop and call off. Shows speculative aggression in multiway but folded to all-in pressure on turn previously. **Exploit**: Iso-raise wide over P7's opens (their range is wide trash). Value bet relentlessly. In reraised pots, get it in with any premium.

2. **Commit or don't enter**: If investing 10%+ of stack, have a plan for the full hand. No more invest-then-fold with marginal hands.
3. **Thin value > bluffing** against stations (P2, P4, P6). Image supports bluffs vs P3/P5 only.
4. **CALL DOWN P4 wider** — their aggression in limped pots can be pure air.
5. **Counter P2**: Flat opens IP, exploit postflop tendencies. Float flops.
6. **Float P2 and P5 on flops** — both shut down on turn without hands.
7. **Multi-street barrels work vs P3 in RAISED pots**. In LIMPED pots, don't bluff P3.
8. **Never bluff sticky P6 (check-calling). RAISE P6's donk-leads (they're air).**
9. **ISO-RAISE P7 aggressively** — their opens are extremely wide.
10. **SIZE DOWN iso-raises vs P6** (~3x) to keep them calling dominated.
